target_id.description: Stable target identifier such as HAL_HUMAN or SMPD1_HUMAN.

ec.description: Full EC number when available, otherwise a family-level value such as 3.1.1.-

reaction.description: Chemical reaction string such as L-histidine -> urocanate + NH3.

cofactor.description: Empty string if no cofactor is known.

structural_fold.description: Known structural fold only when supported by PDB/AlphaFold, otherwise empty string.

catalytic_residues_file.description: Path to the catalytic/pocket residue TSV, relative to the project directory.

structure_file.description: Path to the target PDB or AlphaFold model when available, otherwise empty string.

sequence_file.description: Path to the target sequence FASTA, relative to the project directory.

known_enzymes.description: Curated identifiers/proteins that define the reference enzyme set.

known_microbial_enzymes.description: Known microbial functional analogs used for comparison.

input_source.description: How the target was originally supplied by the user.
